# Nate Mills Design System

> The design system behind natemills.me: DTCG tokens authored once, generated CSS, a small published class API, a portable brand contract and a rulebook for AI coding agents. Everything an agent needs to build on-brand without the repo.

Link the published CSS; never rebuild it from values. The rules are in AGENTS.md, the resolved values in DESIGN.md, the class facts as data in components-api.json, and one page per component in the components folder. Every link below is the public repository's own copy, readable without a login.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/AGENTS.md): the rules, the published class names with examples, the token names, the mistakes to avoid. Read this first.
- [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/DESIGN.md): the portable brand contract. Every colour, type, radius and spacing value resolved, the component recipes, do's and don'ts, voice and tone.
- [components-api.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/components-api.json): the published class API as data. Per class: kind, own selectors, states, parts, descendant rules, the custom properties it reads and sets; an example for each group that has one; the stylesheets in load order.
- [nate-mills-design-system.dsds.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/nate-mills-design-system.dsds.yaml): the whole system as one Design System Doc Spec 0.20.0 document. Every component with its traits and allowed values, invalid combinations, when-to-use and how-to-use guidelines with RFC 2119 levels, each rule's checkedBy and check, its keys and its look-alikes; every published token with its purpose and its DTCG source.
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md in one file.

## Components and foundations

- [Components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/components/README.md): every component, one page each, and the whole inventory: anything not listed is not in the system. Each page gives when to use it, its props (the classes and attributes) with types and defaults, the allowed values, invalid combinations, the keys it answers to, and its rules.
- [Foundations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/foundations/README.md): colour, type, spacing, depth, responsive behaviour, voice and accessibility, one page each.
- [Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/foundations/tokens.md): every token name the published CSS gives you, what each one is for, and its value in light and dark.
- [How rules are checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/foundations/checks.md): what each check behind the component rules does, which WCAG criterion it backs, and when it runs.

## Source

- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/tokens.json): the DTCG token source, three tiers, OKLCH-authored.
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/tokens.css): every custom property in light, dark and high-contrast, as text. To use it on a page, link the natemills.me copy in AGENTS.md's link block; load it before components.css.
- [components.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/main/components.css): the class layer, as text; reads semantic tokens only. Link the natemills.me copy on a page, as AGENTS.md shows.
- [fonts.css](https://natemills.me/assets/fonts.css): self-hosted Anton and JetBrains Mono, with its slashed zero. Required; Work Sans comes from Google Fonts. AGENTS.md has the full link block in order.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system): the mirror of the source, MIT.
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system/tree/main/skills): a skill carrying AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md. Install with `claude plugin marketplace add n8mills-UI/nate-mills-design-system`, then `claude plugin install nate-mills-design-system@nate-mills-design-system`.

## Optional

- [The live design system](https://natemills.me/design-system): the view for people, built with JavaScript; a plain fetch gets one line of text. Agents should read DESIGN.md instead.
- [Portfolio](https://natemills.me/): the site the system runs.
